EXECUTIVE IMPACT BRIEF: AMF1 × COGNIZANT ESG PERFORMANCE

1. OPERATIONAL DECARBONISATION
Direct Scope 1 and 2 emissions decreased by 74% vs baseline [FACT-E-06], with campus solar roof installations driving a 23% emissions reduction [FACT-E-07]. Total Scope 1 stood at 156.57 tCO₂e [FACT-E-01] and market-based Scope 2 at 343.08 tCO₂e [FACT-E-02].

2. VALUE CHAIN & LOGISTICS
Global multi-modal freight generated 5,560.45 tCO₂e [FACT-E-04]. High-integrity SAF certificates abated 1,188 tCO₂e [FACT-E-05], supporting the team's validated SBTi 2030 target [FACT-G-02].

3. SOCIAL & STEM PIPELINE
Make A Mark Week welcomed 300+ students from 14 schools [FACT-C-01], while the Cognizant Gen-AI Ideathon marked its 2nd consecutive year [FACT-C-02]. Over £300,000 was raised for community initiatives [FACT-C-03].

4. AUDIT & GOVERNANCE
AMF1 maintains the highest FIA Three-Star Environmental Accreditation [FACT-G-01].
